g.text: Familiar workflow accuracy hides failures on new combinations

g.text: Four different convention mappings, task orders and datasets; one optimization seed per stream.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Rows describe primitive training history. All seven workflow arms train on 512 current examples without rehearsal.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: A correct answer is a complete JSON program that executes to the expected state and ends with native EOS.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Unfamiliar command combinations were absent from workflow training. Requests explicitly state the steps.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #415465

g.text: Merged adapters retain dense offsets; other rows use rank-8 adapters. These rows are not equal in resident memory.
